About AluComfort

Your home is your refuge.

At AluComfort, with more than 20 years of experience, we believe your home is your refuge. Specialising in home renovations and the replacement of old windows and doors, we offer complete aluminium solutions that combine top aesthetics with real security.

Our philosophy rests on build quality and energy upgrades. With AluComfort you invest in windows and doors with high thermal and sound insulation — comfortable living conditions and noticeable savings on your energy bills all year round.

With responsibility, consistency and attention to detail, our experienced team takes on every stage of the work — from correct measuring and the study of your space to the final, flawless installation.

What we take on

Windows, doors & aluminium services in Lamia

01

Replacing old windows & doors

We remove your old wooden or iron frames quickly and cleanly and install new, energy-efficient aluminium systems that instantly change the look and feel of your home.

02

Energy upgrade & insulation

We help you choose the right profiles and energy-efficient glazing, so heat loss and heating and cooling costs drop noticeably. Ideal for subsidy programmes such as «Exoikonomo».

03

Shading & protection

We fit your windows and balcony doors with modern roller shutters (manual or electric), aluminium shutters and insect screens of every type, for protection from the sun and insects.

04

PVC windows & doors

PVC windows and doors for good thermal and sound insulation with minimal upkeep, in white or coloured finishes.

05

Security entrance doors

Security entrance doors in many designs and finishes — safety that keeps your entrance looking good.

06

Aluminium railings

Railings for balconies, fences and staircases, outdoors and indoors. Aluminium does not rust and never needs painting.

07

Repairs & adjustments

Adjustments, new mechanisms, handles, seals and screens, so your windows and doors close properly again.

08

Survey & measuring at your place

Get in touch and our specialist technician visits your place to take exact measurements and suggest the ideal solution — with no obligation at all.

Energy upgrade

What makes a window insulate

Inside every energy-efficient frame there are a few simple things that keep the cold, the heat and the noise outside. We help you choose the right ones for your home.

  1. Thermal breakA strip that separates the inside of the profile from the outside, so the frame does not carry the cold in.
  2. Energy-efficient double glazingTwo panes with a gap between them — less heat loss and less noise.
  3. Sealing gasketsThey close every gap, against draughts, dust and rain.
  4. Multi-chamber profileInner chambers that make the frame stronger and insulate even better.

How does the measuring work?

You call us and our specialist technician visits your place, takes exact measurements and suggests the ideal solution, with no obligation at all.

Where are you and where do you work?

In Lamia, at the 3rd km of the Lamia – Karpenisi National Road. We take on projects in Lamia and the wider area — call us to discuss yours.

Aluminium or PVC?

Both insulate very well. Aluminium is strong and allows slim profiles and large openings; PVC insulates very well with minimal upkeep. During the visit we tell you what suits your home.

Can the replacement go into «Exoikonomo»?

Replacing frames with energy-efficient ones is among the works covered by programmes such as «Exoikonomo». We help you choose profiles and glazing that meet the programme requirements.

How long does installation take?

It depends on the number and size of the frames. We give you the timeline together with the quote.

Will it make a big mess at home?

Removal and installation are done quickly and cleanly. Before we start, we explain exactly what will happen in your home.
